jd_text: PAGE_CAPTURE_JD_MARKER {{COMPANY}} is hiring a {{ROLE}} to own quality-platform architecture across mobile, web, and backend services. The engineer will build Kotlin automation, Appium and Playwright frameworks, contract and API tests, CI/CD paved roads, containerized test environments, and OpenTelemetry observability. Responsibilities include reliability engineering, test-data systems, release qualification, developer enablement, and measurable improvements to feedback speed. Candidates need eight years of experience leading test infrastructure for distributed engineering organizations.
